# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow the root `AGENTS.md` for all work in this repository.
Start with `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, then the development workflow and product
lifecycle documents linked there. Keep implementation, verification, Git push,
static-preview deployment and tagged release states distinct.

Do not duplicate the rules in this file; keep `AGENTS.md` authoritative for
repository-level guidance, subject to higher-priority platform/user instructions.
